This plot is only small and it is rented, so I do not want to spend money on fertilizer from the cooperative when the harvest will be split or the land may not be mine next year. I will use manure from my animals because that costs me nothing, and I will plant seeds I saved from last year like my neighbors do. Sorghum does not need much spraying, and I have no way to irrigate here — I depend on the rains. My family will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves.
